channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Security Hub now exports findings to S3 in CSV or JSON format
item.description: Today, AWS Security Hub announces support for exporting findings to Amazon S3 in CSV or JSON (OCSF) format. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 R8gd instances are now available in additional regions
item.description: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8gd instances are available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 R8g instances now available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8g instances are available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: From zero to NanoClaw
item.description: Gavriel Cohen, creator of NanoClaw and co-founder of NanoCo, joins Adam to explain how a 40-hour weekend project became a viral open source hit and the foundation of an enterprise AI company. (1 source: changelog)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports reasoning summaries for OpenAI models
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports the reasoning.summary parameter for OpenAI models through the Responses API. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Lambda supports OAuth authentication for self-managed Apache Kafka event sources
item.description: AWS Lambda now supports OAuth authentication for self-managed Apache Kafka event source mappings (ESM), including Kafka clusters that customers run themselves and managed offerings such as Confluent Cloud, Aiven, and Redpanda. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick now supports brand templates for on-brand presentations and documents
item.description: Starting today, you can upload brand templates in Amazon Quick, allowing you to create presentations and documents that match your approved visual identity. (1 source: aws)
